_doc: Q版小人模板（A4 固化，2026-08-14）。对齐方舟 2D 小人（Spine）风格

chibi.style_signature: Arknights chibi style (2D in-game sprite): cute small character about 2-3 heads tall, big head, large expressive eyes, small body, clean thin lineart, soft cel shading, muted warm-gray palette (#B8AD9E #6E6558 #F5F0E8), simple readable silhouette, game-ready sprite look, no heavy outline, no CG plastic skin.
chibi.multi_ref_role: Image 1 is the art-style anchor: learn ONLY its lineart, coloring, shading and sprite finish. Image 2 is an additional same-style detail reference.

views.front: front view, chibi full body, standing facing viewer, big head small body proportions
views.side: side view, chibi full body, profile facing left, same character design as front view
views.back: back view, chibi full body, seen from behind, same character design
views.three_view: character sheet, front / side / back three views, same chibi character, consistent design
views.idle: animation frame, idle pose, chibi, single frame, consistent with reference
views.walk: animation frame, walk cycle pose, chibi, single frame, consistent with reference
views.attack: animation frame, attacking pose, chibi, single frame, consistent with reference
views.hurt: animation frame, hurt pose, chibi, single frame, consistent with reference

chibi.output_constraint: same chibi character, consistent design, no text, no watermark
